# Token mapping

<!-- Generated by `npm run mapping` from migration/*.json: do not edit. -->

How each product's current custom properties map to the brand-neutral `--ui-` tokens. The products are not
migrated yet; this is the plan for that step (see docs/TODO.md). A mapping is by role: the token has the same
meaning, and the product keeps its own values in its brand theme. Variables without a token stay in the
product. Values are as declared in the product file at the commit named below (light / dark for themed
variables).

| Product | File | Last changed in | Variables | Mapped | Stay in product |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| axentra-studio | `src/styles/tokens.css` | `b87e203bb9d7` | 102 | 89 | 13 |
| nodestro-studio | `frontend/src/styles/midnight-citron.css` | `f2905b0889e0` | 53 | 53 | 0 |
| tabrion-studio | `frontend/src/styles/tokens.css` | `98720ba870e0` | 84 | 80 | 4 |

## axentra-studio (`--ax-`)

- The package follows this structure (categories, semantic colors, contrast test), so most names map one to one with --ax- replaced by --ui-.
- Brand primitives, gradients and the hex motif stay in the product's brand theme. App-shell dimensions stay in the product until the admin package.
- The sidebar (navy in both themes) maps to the nav roles; the brand theme sets the same navy values for both themes.

## nodestro-studio (`--nd-`)

- Dark is the default theme of the product; in this package light is the default. The product keeps its default by setting data-theme on <html>.
- Colors, radii and durations map by role. The product keeps its values (citron brand, larger radii, 130/220ms) in its own brand theme.
- Font sizes map to the nearest step of the shared scale (rem, 16px root). Two sizes change by 1-2px at migration unless the brand theme keeps them.

## tabrion-studio (`--tb-`)

- Same structure as axentra-studio; names map one to one with --tb- replaced by --ui-, except the ones below.
- Radii map by role (sm = controls, lg = cards); the product keeps 4/6/10px in its brand theme.
- The density switch (data-density='normal': 36px rows and controls) stays in the product; it sets --ui-row-height and --ui-control-height.
- Environment badges (DEV/TEST/PROD) map to the neutral, warning and danger roles; the product may keep --tb-env-* as aliases.
